bookingHelp: Choose a supported Banani route and passenger quantity. A request waits until a driver accepts.
quantityHelp: Quantity only, up to three passenger seats; no numbered seat selection.

cashOnly: Cash only. Cash collection is not tracked.
pendingRecovery: This command is awaiting confirmation. Keep the original command and retry to reconcile its result.
errorPENDING_COMMAND: Resolve the pending command before starting another.
errorINVALID_SEAT_QUANTITY: Choose one, two or three passenger seats.

demoGeography: Configured demonstration geography; distances are not live routing estimates.

reasonRequired: Enter a reason between 1 and 200 characters.
dispatchHelp: Relevant waiting requests, oldest first. Availability and capacity are confirmed again when you accept.
offlineHelp: Go online to accept waiting requests.
noRequests: No relevant waiting requests. A full or closed pool cannot accept another booking.
